name: Lentil & Mushroom Sloppy Joes with Avocado-Spinach Salad

instructions.primary_message: Using a strainer or colander, rinse lentils under cold water; drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Add broth and salt, then bring to a boil over high heat. Reduce heat to a simmer, cover, and cook until tender, 15-20 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
12 fl oz (1 ½ cups) chicken or vegetable broth
salt

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
½ lb cremini mushrooms
1 green bell pepper
½ avocado
½ (5 oz) pkg baby spinach

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince onion and garlic; transfer both to a medium bowl.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ medium yellow onion
1 clove garlic

instructions.primary_message: Roughly chop mushrooms. Trim, seed, and roughly chop pepper. Add both to the bowl.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat. Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add vegetables, sugar, and spices to the skillet; stir to combine. Cook, stirring occasionally, until the vegetables are tender-crisp, 3-4 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
brown sugar
½ tsp paprika
salt
¼ tsp chili powder

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, place oil, vinegar, Dijon, sugar, and salt in the bowl used for the veggies. Whisk to combine the dressing and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
extra virgin olive oil
2 tsp apple cider vinegar
1 tsp Dijon mustard
brown sugar
salt

instructions.primary_message: Add tomato sauce to the skillet, stir to combine, and bring to a simmer. Once simmering, reduce heat to medium-low, and continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until the vegetables are tender, 3-4 minutes.
Meanwhile, halve and pit avocado. Slice thinly while still in skin, then scoop out into the bowl with the dressing. Add spinach and toss to combine the salad.
When the lentils are tender, drain, and add to the skillet with the vegetables; stir to combine the sloppy joe mix.
To serve, place the bottom half of a bun on each plate. Top with sloppy joe mix and close with top half of the bun. Divide salad between plates and enjoy!
